summary.text: Magic 2010's story, told in The Veil's Curse webcomic of July and August 2009, follows the necromancer Liliana Vess on Shandalar, where the demon Kothophed sends her to find the Chain Veil.
Enhanced by the veil, Liliana dispatches Garruk in the Onakke temple, and she then blows Kothophed apart, though her tattoos begin to bleed.
Jace Beleren also appears in the set's tale, in which Garruk and Jace are the other characters caught up in the veil's curse.
